title: Samsung NX60 — Error history recall
description: Display stored failure codes before service (§4-1).

steps.title: Enter error history
steps.body: Clock → 1,2,3,4 (Timer OFF) → Start/Set → hold Clock + 1 for 3 s. Error codes display.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Clock → 1,2,3,4 (Timer OFF) → Start/Set → hold Clock + 1 for 3 s. Error codes display.

steps.title: Scroll stored codes
steps.body: Press 0 to display latest 5 error codes. Press Off/Clear to exit.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press 0 to display latest 5 error codes. Press Off/Clear to exit.
